findings.description: This role is administrator-equivalent: its effective permissions allow every action on every resource. Its 64 individual privilege-escalation and dangerous-permission findings are summarised here.
findings.remediation: Treat this principal as an account administrator: limit who can use it (trust policy, group membership, credentials), require MFA, and replace broad grants (Action:* or iam:*) by the permissions it needs.
findings.title: Administrator-equivalent principal

findings.description: The trust policy of 'wildcard-open' allows Principal '*' without conditions: any AWS account can assume it.
findings.remediation: Restrict Principal to specific accounts or role ARNs; conditions on Principal: * are only as strong as their weakest key.
findings.title: Role 'wildcard-open' trusts any AWS principal (Principal: *)

findings.description: Unrestricted S3 access across all buckets
findings.remediation: Restrict to specific actions and resource ARNs
findings.title: Unrestricted S3 access across all buckets

findings.description: The trust policy of 'bare-account' allows '999999999999' from account 999999999999; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'bare-account' trusts account 999999999999

findings.description: The trust policy of 'string-trust' allows 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:root' from account 000000000000; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'string-trust' trusts account 000000000000

findings.description: The kms key's resource policy grants kms:Decrypt to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account use of the key is intended; remove accounts that should not use it.
findings.title: KMS key 'alias/demo-shared' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The secret's resource policy grants secretsmanager:GetSecretValue to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account access to the secret is intended; scope the Principal to specific role ARNs or add aws:PrincipalOrgID.
findings.title: Secret 'demo/shared' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The trust policy of 'deploy' allows 'arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/deploy' from account 999999999999; guard: none.
findings.remediation: Verify the cross-account trust is intended; restrict it to specific role ARNs and require sts:ExternalId (third parties) or aws:PrincipalOrgID (your organisation).
findings.title: Role 'deploy' trusts principal 999999999999

findings.remediation: Require the provider's audience (<host>:aud) and an exact subject (<host>:sub), e.g. repo:<org>/<repo>:ref:refs/heads/main for GitHub or system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa> for EKS.
findings.title: Role 'gha-deploy' trusts github identities (pattern subjects)

findings.description: The IAM password policy is below common baselines: password reuse prevention None < 24.
findings.remediation: Set an account password policy: length >= 14, all character classes, reuse prevention 24.
findings.title: The account password policy is weak

findings.description: The trust policy of 'audit' allows 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root' from account 111122223333; guard: external-id.
findings.remediation: The trust requires sts:ExternalId; keep the value secret per customer and restrict the principal to the vendor's specific role ARN.
findings.title: Role 'audit' trusts account 111122223333

findings.description: Users of the SAML identity provider can assume the role (AssumeRoleWithSAML).
findings.remediation: Confirm the SAML provider and its attribute mapping only admit intended users.
